title: Larger text when the portal feels too small
description:
PipeShare and PipeSync now have a Text size control in the site menu, under your name and the theme picker. The choices are Small, Medium, Large, and Extra large. Medium is the size the site uses today.

Picking a size changes the text, buttons, and spacing right away. The choice is remembered in that browser, so it is still there after a refresh. The video picture and the pipe drawing stay put.

Who is affected: the website on the private server and on SaaS. The desktop app people already installed does not have this control yet. Desktop 0.3.23 is unchanged.

This release also keeps the upload and heartbeat fixes already saved: presign and complete no longer wait on a DB3 import, heartbeats answer without sitting in that line, and nginx no longer treats a short restart as a ten-second outage. Folder sharing from the previous save is included too: an admin can give one person a folder, including everything inside it, without opening the rest of that client.
changeLog: The site menu has a Text size control: Small, Medium, Large, and Extra large.
Medium matches today's size. Larger steps grow the shell, menus, and file list together.
The choice applies immediately and is remembered in the browser.
The video frame and pipe drawing keep their layout.
Presign, complete, and heartbeat stay responsive when many people upload.
An admin can share one folder, including everything inside it, without opening the rest of the client.
